quotes.text: AppSource is Microsoft's online marketplace for business solutions. Think of it like a mall. But instead of selling clothes or electronics, every store sells software, services, and templates that work with Microsoft products.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear definition with an accessible analogy.

quotes.text: Then there's co-sell. This is probably the most powerful feature that most people don't know about. If an offering is co-sell eligible, Microsoft's own sales team can recommend it to their customers.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Highlights an underused distribution channel for partners.

quotes.text: AppSource is a marketplace for third-party solutions that work with Microsoft products. Independent software vendors publish there.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Debunks the myth that AppSource only lists Microsoft products.

quotes.text: The extension model means no permanent changes to your environment. If it doesn't work for you, remove it and move on.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Lowers the perceived risk of trying marketplace solutions.

quotes.text: You don't open the App Store just to buy one thing. You open it because it's the front door to everything your phone can do. AppSource works the same way for your Microsoft investment.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Captures the episode's big-picture idea of AppSource as a system.

chapters.title: The big picture and next steps

takeaways: Microsoft AppSource is a marketplace for business solutions, offering apps and extensions, consulting services, and templates and data services that work with Microsoft products.
It connects Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure and Microsoft 365 in one search, and since September 2025 it is unified with Azure Marketplace as Microsoft Marketplace.
Free trials, transactable offers on existing Microsoft billing, private offers and co-sell make it a low-risk buying channel for customers and a go-to-market channel for partners and ISVs.
hook: Finding the right business solution for your Microsoft stack used to mean googling vendors and chasing trials. This episode explains Microsoft AppSource for IT pros, business owners, consultants and ISVs: what you can find there, how it plugs into Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure and Microsoft 365, and how trials, transactable offers and co-sell work.
